title: Rabbami – Rabbasi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says this is what Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Assi are called in the Jerusalem Talmud, as in Avodah Zarah, chapter 5, halakhah 11, and in several places.[^1]

notes.text: The two whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:11 paragraphs give full Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Assi and the joined forms Rabbimmi and Rabbassi in a reported query. Hyman’s supplied רבמי–רבסי heading and several-places claim remain; this is no whole-corpus count, authority merge, or importation of the legal discussion.
